reports.title: MARTIN MARIETTA REPORTS RECORD THIRD-QUARTER 2026 RESULTS AND UPDATES FULL-YEAR 2026 GUIDANCE

guidance.heading: Updated 2026 Guidance
section: Based on strong acquisition performance, partially offset by softer heritage demand and inflationary cost pressures, the Company is updating its full-year 2026 guidance.

desk.headline: Revenue up 28% to a record $2.37bn on acquisitions, beat; adjusted EPS down 11% to $5.47; 2026 revenue and EBITDA outlook raised after LNA deal
results: Record revenue of $2.37bn (+28%) and adjusted EBITDA of $808m (+21%), driven by acquisitions; GAAP EPS fell 34% to $3.94 on deal-related charges.
Aggregates volumes hit a record 67.1m tons, but organic shipments dipped and the average price fell 4% because acquired quarries sell for less.
Aggregates gross profit fell 4% to $512m on higher depreciation and energy costs.
The $12.9bn Lhoist North America (LNA) deal closed on 21 Aug and added $216m of revenue; Specialties revenue nearly tripled to $362m.
Debt rose to about $12.8bn after the deal; $361m was returned to shareholders in the first nine months.

guidance.summary: Full-year 2026 revenue and adjusted EBITDA ranges were lifted to include LNA, which more than offsets weaker demand and higher costs in the existing business. The EBITDA midpoint is below what analysts expected.

points: Management expects mid- to high-single-digit mix-adjusted aggregates price growth in 2027, led by 1 January price rises.
Diesel is a cost headwind of about $25m a quarter; excluding diesel, organic cost per ton rose about 2.6%.
Data centre volumes more than doubled and infrastructure is solid, but housing and light commercial work softened in September and October.
Fourth-quarter organic volumes are expected to fall by a high-single-digit percentage.
LNA integration is on track, with about $820m of LNA EBITDA expected in 2027; about $500m of debt is to be repaid in Q4 on the way to 2–2.5x leverage.
call.source: Call transcript (The Motley Fool via Mitrade) and StockStory, 5 Nov 2026
